q1: SELECT f1.drinker, f2.drinker FROM (SELECT drinker, SUM(times_a_week) AS st FROM frequents GROUP BY drinker) AS f1, (SELECT drinker, SUM(times_a_week) AS st FROM frequents GROUP BY drinker) AS f2 WHERE f1.drinker < f2.drinker AND f1.st = f2.st
q2: SELECT a.drinker, b.drinker FROM Frequents AS a CROSS JOIN Frequents AS b WHERE a.drinker <> b.drinker AND a.bar = b.bar AND a.times_a_week = b.times_a_week

Q1 does not consider the specific bar, only the total frequency, which can lead to different results.
